description: Ministry of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs - Notice of entry that BEdHons (Physical Sc) Degree to the KIU, that published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1961/34 of 08.04.2016
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the amendment of a university degree program through an order made under the Universities Act. It involves the Minister exercising statutory powers to modify regulations (specifically, adding a new degree to Schedule II of a previous order). This constitutes a regulatory matter involving subsidiary legislation under an existing Act, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette. While it mentions a specific minister, it does so in the context of exercising legal authority rather than announcing a personnel change or detailing portfolio responsibilities.
